title: [Job-31207] Data Analyst, UK - 6 Month FTC
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


Senior Data Analyst
We're seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our client's team in Central London. You'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed decision-making through advanced A/B testing, statistical analysis, and enterprise-level business intelligence solutions.
 
This is a client-facing position where you'll work embedded within the client's team, requiring strong autonomy, initiative, and the ability to represent CI&T professionally. This is a hybrid role requiring 3-4 days per week on-site at the client's Central London offices (Euston area).
 
 
Position Overview
A/B Testing & Statistical Analysis
Design, implement, and analyze A/B tests to measure product and feature performance
Apply statistical methods to ensure test validity and generate actionable insights
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders
Business Intelligence & Data Modeling
Design, build, and optimize semantic data models in Power BI for self-service analytics and enterprise reporting
Develop and maintain high-performance Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets
Partner with data engineering teams to define and validate data pipelines in Databricks
Ensure seamless integration between data sources and BI models
Data Governance & Collaboration
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable BI solutions
Implement best practices in data governance, performance optimization, and security
Monitor and resolve data quality, integrity, and dashboard performance issues
Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders on data analytics matters
 
Must Haves
Power BI Expertise: 3+ years developing enterprise-level dashboards and semantic data models
Statistical Analysis: Strong capability in experimental design, A/B testing methodologies, and statistical inference
Technical Skills:
Advanced SQL for complex queries and data manipulation
Python for data analysis and automation (pandas, numpy, scipy, etc.)
Data Engineering Knowledge: Familiarity with ETL processes, data integration tools, and modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks)
Data Visualization: Proven ability to transform complex data into clear, compelling visual narratives
Communication: Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills; fluent English (written and verbal)
Working Style: Demonstrated autonomy, initiative, and ability to work independently in client environments
 
#LI-BM2
 
Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard. 
We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

title: Director, Product Data Analyst Team
description:

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. In close collaboration with three different VP/SVP of Product, you will leverage data with your team to drive strategic decision-making and optimize product performance. This role is integral to our product team, ensuring data-driven decisions guide our product strategy and innovation efforts. 

You’ll join the Product Insights department, composed of the Product Data Analytics team and Product Research team. In charge of having a 360 customer knowledge view, we combine quantitative and qualitative insights to inform the product roadmap.  Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Insights, you will ensure your team is aligned with the broader company goals and operates with the velocity required to influence strategic decision-making.

 

What you'll do

title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
  • Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
  • Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
  • Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
  • Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
  • You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
  • You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
  • You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.

This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.


Your challenge

  • Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
  • Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
  • Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
  • Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
  • Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
  • Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
  • Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
  • Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing tools, and large-scale geospatial datasets


Your profile

  • A degree in geoinformatics, remote sensing, geography, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or another quantitative/technical field
  • Hands-on experience working with geospatial data and GIS tools, ideally QGIS
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data or technical issues in a structured way
  • A high level of ownership and self-management - you ask questions, seek clarity, and proactively move problems toward resolution
  • Comfortable using AI coding and analysis tools as part of your daily work, while applying your own judgement to verify results
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and customer requirements can change
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You live in Berlin or are willing to relocate

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Python and SQL
  • Remote sensing / Earth Observation experience
  • Experience with geodatabases and large-scale data management
  • AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience
  • Machine learning or deep learning knowledge
  • Software engineering experience
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to work with satellite and geospatial data on real-world infrastructure challenges across the globe and contribute directly to how LiveEO delivers its analytics products.
  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.
  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.
  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons, with the opportunity to learn across geospatial analytics, AI and satellite technology.
  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, Jobrad, corporate pension program.
  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.

title: Operations analyst - Payments
description:
Hybrid with 2 days a week in our Edinburgh office

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform that’s on a mission to helping more people to invest – and invest well.

We’re B-Corp certified with an amazing product-market fit, impressive early traction and the potential to transform an outdated industry, for the better. We've been growing fast and will scale even faster over the next few years.

We’re also proud to be part of Octopus, the £multi billion group that's on a mission to breathe new life into broken industries, through companies like Octopus Energy, Octopus Investments and Octopus Money.

Check out the Seccl website for the latest on our products and our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

Our Operations analysts are part of collaborative, cross-functional teams of engineers, product owners, and operations analysts united by an absolute focus on problem solving, innovating, and delivering great customer outcomes. These are teams of experts, big thinkers, and fast learners who love to get stuff done.

As an Operations analyst in our Payments team, you’ll support with the day to day operations across all our product types. You will be in close contact with all areas of the Operations team to ensure we maintain high standards of service during an exciting period of accelerated growth. We’re looking for candidates who have previous experience in a similar role.

On a typical day you will be…

  • Supporting your Operations delivery lead with regular business reporting

  • An analytical problem solver, delivery focussed and a trusted member of the team, you will support the wider business by answering queries in a timely manner

  • Investigating and taking end to end ownership of our cash processes. Ensuring issues are resolved in line with regulatory and customer agreed SLAs

  • Reviewing operational workflow and, where possible, suggesting process improvements

  • Working closely with the customer, product and engineering teams to explore better ways of working and to support our scalability

  • Supporting with training for new members of the team

  • Supporting other areas of Operations as and when required

What you’ll own

  • Owning the end-to-end investigation and resolution of cash process issues, ensuring regulatory and customer agreed SLAs are met

  • Delivering accurate business reporting that supports operational performance and decision making

  • Resolving complex queries promptly and becoming a trusted operational partner across the business

  • Working with Customer, Product and Engineering to improve customer outcomes and develop scalable ways of working

  • Identifying and driving improvements to operational workflows and cash processes

  • Building capability across the team by supporting new starter training and sharing your knowledge

  • Contributing across Operations to maintain high service standards as Seccl grows

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a good understanding of the Investment Management industry

  • You can identify, analyse and resolve any complex issues working to strict deadlines

  • You have a great domain knowledge of investment platforms, particularly knowledge of the CASS environment

  • You have communication and organisation skills with the ability to describe to both technical and non-technical audiences

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

💰 A salary between £30,000 and £35,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate - our recognition programme that offers a mix of flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this, (following an initial chat with one of our Talent team):
